events.info: The Frankie Moreno Trio Six-time Las Vegas , "rdquo" -> Headliner of the Year" Frankie Moreno returns to Blue Note Hawaii by popular demand with his acclaimed FRANKIE MORENO TRIO. Known for his electrifying performances, world-class musicianship, and genre-defying style, Moreno has sold millions of records worldwide and holds the world record for the most #1 singles in iTunes chart history with an incredible 124 chart-toppers. Joined by his brother Tony Moreno on bass and son Giovanni Moreno on drums, the Moreno family takes the stage for an unforgettable evening of high-energy musicianship, spontaneous moments, and fresh new arrangements of Frankie's biggest hits, fan favorites, and selections from their brand-new trio album. From rock 'n' roll and blues to jazz, soul, and beyond, every performance is unique. No tracks. No gimmicks. Just three musicians pushing each other to the limit and bringing the room along for the ride.
